features.feature_description: At claim intimation or anytime after the start of monthly income, the Claimant can convert outstanding monthly income into a lump sum payout. Discount rates apply (6.50% p.a. at intimation; higher of 6.50% and 10-year G-Sec yield after first payment).

Provides coverage against death only. Death Benefit payable is higher of 7 times Annualized Premium, 105% of Total Premiums Paid, or Sum Assured on Death (for Regular/Limited Pay); or higher of 125% of Single Premium or Sum Assured on Death (for Single Pay).

Provides coverage against death and Accidental Death Benefit (ADB). Sum Assured on Death and ADB Sum Assured are set at purchase and remain constant throughout the policy term. ADB is an additional lump sum for accidental death.

Provides coverage against death and Accidental Death Benefit (ADB) with varying Sum Assured. Sum Assured on Death increases from 25% (Year 1) to 100% (Year 11 onwards) of chosen Sum Assured. ADB Sum Assured decreases from 75% (Year 1) to 0% (Year 11 onwards) of chosen Sum Assured. ADB is payable only for the first 10 policy years.

If the Life Assured is diagnosed with a Terminal Illness (highly likely to lead to death within 6 months), the Death Benefit is accelerated and paid. This is not an additional benefit; the policy terminates upon payment. Not available for policies sourced through POS personnel.

your loved ones by providing the ﬂexibility to take the Death Beneﬁt in a way that meets your family’s 
ﬁnancial requirement. The Death Beneﬁt payout option has to be selected by you at Policy inception and

Under the Life and Life Plus variant, there are four payout options for the Death Beneﬁt payable in the 
event of death or diagnosis of Terminal Illness of the Life Assured:
1. Lump Sum Option – Entire Death Beneﬁt amount is payable as lump sum.
2. Income Option – 10% of the death beneﬁt amount is payable every year for 10 years. This will be paid 
 in equal monthly instalments in advance at the rate of 0.83333% of Death Beneﬁt amount. Sum of total 
 monthly beneﬁts payable over 10 years is equal to the death beneﬁt amount. 
 The Claimant can also advance the ﬁrst year’s income as lump sum. The monthly income will start from 
 the subsequent month for 9 years at the rate of 0.80% of the Death Beneﬁt amount.

3. Lump sum and Income Option – If this option is chosen then,  the death beneﬁt will be paid as a 
 combination of income and lump sum payout options, where the percentage of death beneﬁt paid out 
 as lump sum will have to be chosen at the policy inception. The remaining death beneﬁt amount will be 
 paid out in equal monthly instalments in advance at the rate 0.83333% per month over 10 years.
4. Increasing Income Option – The Death Beneﬁt amount is payable in monthly instalments for 10 years

 10% p.a. simple interest every year thereafter. The sum of total monthly beneﬁts payable over 10 years
